meta.title: Download the player for Android and desktop
meta.description: Download the SignageWall player for Android or desktop and pair a screen in seconds.

hero.title: Download the SignageWall player.
hero.subtitle: A lightweight app that turns any TV or computer into a smart screen. Install it, enter the pairing code, and the screen is ready.

platforms.title: Choose your platform.

android.name: Android
android.body: For Android TV, TV boxes and Android devices. Ideal for screens around your space.

desktop.name: Desktop
desktop.body: For Windows and macOS computers and mini-PCs connected to a screen.

platforms.unavailableNote: The build is not public yet — get in touch and we will send it to you.

items.title: Install
items.body: Download and run the SignageWall player on the device connected to your screen.

items.title: Pair
items.body: The player shows a six-character code — enter it in your dashboard to link the screen to your account.

items.title: Publish
items.body: Send content from the panel — and the screen comes to life instantly.

note: No account yet? Get in touch and we will help you set up your first screen.
